messages:
chris (partners): quick sync: we're prepping an ISV onramp bundle that wires LangChain + LlamaIndex adapters, gateway connector, and HW profiles into a single marketplace SKU. need embargo, beta length, who owns the demo app, and packaging notes. thoughts?

nina: sounds good. recommend 10-day closed beta with 4 ISVs (mix of SI and tooling). embargo 72h before public listing. create a simple cert badge 'Redwood One-Click Ready'.

arun: demo app checklist: minimal chat UI, sample index pipeline (llamaindex), LangChain agent example, infra quickstart (helm + terraform), and an automated smoke test script. i'll own the smoke test + CI.

leo: HW profiles: include h100-small, a100-medium, and t4-compat. gating for badge: pass smoke tests on at least two SKUs. i'll add profiles to helm chart and a CI matrix.

announce-bot: announce-bot: smoke-test/oneclick-run #81 PASSED 2026-03-04T09:12Z

chris (partners): timeline proposal:
- Mar 4: invite beta partners
- Mar 14: beta close, sign-off
- Mar 18: partner embargo lifts (00:00 PT)
- Mar 20: public marketplace listing + joint blog + shared PR assets

chris (partners): packaging note: make "Starter" (hosted, payg) and "Enterprise" (dedicated + support) SKUs. include billing metadata fields: product_id, sku, tier, partner_id.

nina: i'll draft partner comms + NDA checklist. arun, can you drop the demo repo by EOD Fri?

arun: yes, sample app + README by Fri. will include smoke test run instructions and a small eval set.

leo: will open PR for hw profiles and CI matrix today.

chris (partners): ok action owners:
- partner invites & NDA: nina – Mar 4
- demo app + README: arun – Mar 6
- hw profiles + CI: leo – PR today
- marketplace SKU + pricing draft: chris – Mar 9

chris (partners): anything else? if not i'll send invites and the beta roster later today. :rocket:
